title: NashSki Jet Ski Rentals
specs: Located at Blue Turtle Bay Marina with easy lake access
Premium marina launch and safety-focused check-in
Must be 21 years or older to rent
Operators born after Jan 1, 1989 must have valid boating certification
Operators ages 16-20 must agree to rental and safety agreement
All operators must present valid government-issued photo ID and required boating certification
includes: Fuel included for rentals 3 hours and longer; fuel options for shorter rentals
gap: Exact cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests rent jet skis from Blue Turtle Bay Marina and ride on Old Hickory Lake. Rentals accommodate 1-2 riders and include options for standard and premium jet skis. The location offers easy lake access and nearby food and drinks.
extraNote: Complete liability waiver before arrival · NashSki staff refuels jet skis upon return for rentals 3 hours and longer · Self-refuel option available for shorter rentals with customer paying for fuel used · Blue Turtle Bay Marina on Old Hickory Lake
